title: 1. HALFAYA PASS ASSAULT
name: HALFAYA PASS ASSAULT

situation_report.context: Operation Battleaxe was a British offensive to relieve Tobruk and push back Rommel's forces. The attack on Halfaya Pass was crucial to opening the coastal route. German forces had fortified the pass with 88mm guns and created strong defensive positions.
situation_report.strategic_situation: The British need to break through the Axis defenses at Halfaya Pass to advance along the coast road toward Tobruk. German forces under Generalmajor Bach have created a formidable defensive position with interlocking fields of fire.

terrain.special_rules: Elevated position, good fields of fire

special_rules: Defender may place up to 3 additional terrain pieces (trenches, obstacles, etc.)

battle.description: The Britishs are launching an assault to capture key objectives. The Germans must hold their positions and repel the attack.
battle.attacker_objective: Capture the primary objective and break the enemy's will to fight
battle.defender_objective: Hold the objective and inflict sufficient casualties to stop the assault

objectives.attacker_victory: Control the primary objective at game end AND have not reached your Battle Rating limit
objectives.defender_victory: Control the primary objective at game end OR force the attacker to reach their Battle Rating limit

deployment.attacker_zone: Attacker's table edge, up to 12" onto table
deployment.defender_zone: Defender's table edge, up to 18" onto table (prepared positions)
deployment.turn_order: Attacker has initiative and goes first

special_scenario_rules: Prepared Positions: Defender's units in cover at start gain +1 to pinning tests
Assault Doctrine: Attacker's units within 12" of objective gain +1 to assault moves

alternative_forces.description: This scenario uses historical forces for the battle, but players can choose alternative forces from their own model collections. To fit this scenario choose any battlegroup from the British and German army lists.
suggestions: Use forces from the same time period (June 15-17, 1941)
Adjust points budgets proportionally for different scales
Swap nations but keep force structure similar
